newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill on APAC Tele.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill on APAC Tele.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch analyst Fran Bernstein said she expected 1997 revenues at APAC TeleServices Inc to decline by $30 million to $80 million from United Parcel Service of America Inc. one of its large clients.
-- reduced rating to near-term accumulate from buy, and kept the long-term rating at buy.
-- company said on Monday that it expected earnings, revenues and margins to be hurt over the balance of 1997 by costs from a large outsourcing client.
-- analyst reduced the earnings estimate to $0.80 per share from $0.97 for 1997, and to range $1.10-$1.15 from $1.35 for 1998.
